title: User Understanding
summary: Apply user context, needs, assumptions, and constraints in practical work.

levelDescriptors.text: You have not yet studied or practiced user context, needs, assumptions, and constraints.
You can explain user context, needs, assumptions, and constraints, but have not applied them in a project.
With a tutorial, template, or reviewer guiding you, you can frame a user problem using observed behavior rather than preference.
Independently, you can frame a user problem using observed behavior rather than preference and explain your choices.
You have used this skill in a real context to frame a user problem using observed behavior rather than preference, received feedback, and can explain the outcome and trade-offs.
